About Booking Holdings Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world’s leading provider of online travel and related services, provided to consumers and local partners in more than 220 countries and territories through five primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit BookingHoldings.com and follow us on X BookingHoldings. About Booking Holdings Romania: Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania, opened in September 2021. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leveraging industry best practices, and fostering collaboration opportunities across Booking Holdings’ brands and business units. Booking Holdings Romania is supporting Booking Holdings and its portfolio of brands by providing capabilities in many important areas like Security & Fraud, Application Development, Data Analytics, Data Governance, IT End-User Support, Global Business Services, Marketing, Procurement, Legal & Compliance, Privacy, as well as Program Management Office, with new competences in other areas being added throughout the coming years.
Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands.As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the worlds leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through six-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK, OpenTable. Role description At Booking Holdings, scaling our platform is not just a goal; it is a mission-critical requirement. We process massive amounts of data and traffic daily, requiring fault-tolerant, highly available, and secure infrastructure. We are seeking a Senior Java Software Engineer to drive technical excellence, architect scalable solutions, and mentor the next generation of engineers in our Bucharest Centre of Excellence.In this role, you will go beyond writing code. You will shape the architecture of our distributed systems--whether you are designing mechanisms to thwart cyber threats, integrating major global travel partners, or building platform tools that empower hundreds of internal engineering teams. This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week.Key Job Responsibilities and DutiesDesign for Scale: Design and evolve scalable, resilient backend services for high-traffic distributed systems, making sound technical trade-offs.End-to-End Ownership: Own the full software lifecycle--from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production support.Technical Leadership: Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, mentoring, technical design discussions, and driving improvements beyond your own work.Drive Reliability: Improve system reliability through observability, automation, and operational excellence.Collaborate & Influence: Partner effectively with engineers, product managers, and architects, influencing technical decisions and driving initiatives to successful delivery.Tech youll use:Core: Java (Spring Boot) at scale, alongside Python or other server-side languages.Data & Event-Driven Architecture: Kafka Streams, Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redis, relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL).Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless architectures, Terraform.CI/CD & Monitoring: GitLab, Harness, Grafana, OpenTelemetry.Role Qualifications and RequirementsExperience: 5+ years of backend software engineering experience with strong Java expertise and demonstrated ownership of complex production systems.Distributed Systems: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating scalable microservices, SOA, or event-driven architectures in cloud environments (AWS preferred).Cloud & Cloud-Native Engineering: Proven experience building and operating applications on AWS, with hands-on knowledge of cloud-native patterns including load balancing, API gateways, resilience, observability, and container orchestration.AI-Driven Engineering: Proven ability to leverage modern AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate software delivery, improve and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex production issues, make sound technical
